name: add
description: Adds two numbers and produces a result. The numbers must have type float or int and the result will be float or int type.
syntax_line: add {addend1} and {addend2} and store result in {addResult}

id_1.description: Addend1 must be a whole number or float

invalidValues.description: A string is provided as addend1

id_2.description: Addend2 must be a whole number or float

invalidValues.description: A string is provided as addend2
